items.title: GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring is now included in the AWS Security Hub Threat Analytics plan
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces that Amazon GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring is now included in the AWS Security Hub Threat Analytics plan.

items.title: AWS Well-Architected Agent is now available in preview
items.blurb: AWS announces the preview of AWS Well-Architected Agent, a AI-powered service that is the next-gen evolution of AWS Trusted Advisor and the AWS Well-Architected Tool.

items.title: Amazon GuardDuty now supports centralized management using AWS Organizations declarative policies
items.blurb: Amazon GuardDuty now supports AWS Organizations declarative policies, enabling you to centrally enable GuardDuty threat detection across every account and Region in your AWS organization.

items.title: Amazon Redshift now supports cross-Region queries for your data lake
items.blurb: Amazon Redshift now supports querying Amazon S3 data lake tables located in a different AWS Region. With enhanced VPC routing, data lake query traffic between Amazon S3 and Amazon Redshift stays within your own VPC.

items.title: Amazon DynamoDB introduces filtered export to Amazon S3
items.blurb: Amazon DynamoDB now supports filtered export for tables. Export to Amazon S3 allows you to export your table data for analytics, data sharing, and other offline uses, as either a full export or an incremental export over a time window.

items.title: Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) is now available in additional Regions
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces the availability of Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) in 17 additional AWS Regions: Asia Pacific (Hong Kong), Asia Pacific (Hyderabad), Asia Pacific (Jakarta), Asia Pacific (Malaysia), Asia Pacific (Melbourne), Asia…

items.title: Envoy Gateway 1.9.1 Tightens Security and Addresses a Difficult Upgrade Path
items.blurb: Envoy Gateway has released v1.9.1, a maintenance release that focuses heavily on security, upgrade reliability, and operational correctness following the broader v1.9 release. By Craig Risi
